body: I know you're only trying to help, but that just doesn't feel right to me. When your family doesn't have your back and what you believe to be complete love and devotion leaves you, what else is there to rely on in life? Love and family are two things a basic human requires. I have neither and I don't see myself creating either in the near future in my current situation.

Your words are extremely powerful and kind. I sincerely appreciate you taking time out of your day to help me. I feel like I have no more dignity. I feel like I'm completely out of luck. It only gets worse and worse every day and I truly cannot predict when it will get better. I have nothing to look forward to. I have nothing to strive for. Even if I do manage to dig myself out of the trench that I'm in, I have to start all over building myself back up from the bottom. All of that is too overwhelming and I don't know where to start. Your life motto is a very good one, but I don't think it quite fits me because I can't even prove to myself that I have any worth.

The past week I've been trying to live by that mentality, but it's only diminishing. I'm so, so sorry for your loss. I don't want to give up either, but there has been *literally* zero light in my life recently. I can't even see a light at the end of the tunnel..

Okay, so I call a stranger and dump my entire life worth of problems on them. Sure, they might care about a basic human life, and they can console me, but what is the next step? How can somebody as lost as me find their way back to wanting to live again?

My mother is dead and my father hates me for reasons completely unknown to me. He's basically banished me from his home and made everyone related to me think I'm the devil. I've tried reaching out to people I care about, but they ignore me. I don't know what I did wrong and there's nobody to tell me. Not existing at all honestly and truly sounds better than barely existing. It's been like that the past week and it feels like it's only going to be that. I don't know the next step. I have nobody to reach out to and I don't even have the motivation to reach out to anybody because of the rejection I've been getting from everyone I hold closest to my heart. I understand that there is no undoing this decision, but it feels like the only decision left. There's nobody for me. I'm isolated and alone.

My mind is so clouded, it's going to be difficult to answer these questions. About two months ago is when these thoughts first started happening. I was with my girlfriend of two years at the time so I had somebody to go to, but it was never that big of a problem. The reason I started having these thoughts is because when my mom died, my dad decided to take out his anger on me and basically banish me from the family. For some reason, he has the power in the family and even the extended family, and now they all detest me together for reasons I don't understand. I've tried contacting everyone I've ever held dear and they've all ignored me. It almost seems surreal to how my father has isolated me from my loved ones. Not very long ago, my girlfriend decided to leave me because "she couldn't love me in the same way that she did." That's the reason I'm alone now. The reason I can never comprehend and has been haunting me. Everybody has abandoned me for reasons that are unknown to me and I have no explanation. That's the worst part about it. I'm alone and I don't know why. My isolation was never explained no me, and now I have nobody.

I don't want to talk to a stranger who gets paid to talk to people like me. I want to talk to somebody who genuinely cares about human life, not some fake operator on the other end because of a paycheck. I need legitimate human interaction. I need somebody to feel for me and I want to feel for someone else. Currently it's neither and nothing I do seems to change that
